messages.subject: Seed used in RStan
parts: Is there an easy way to know what seed is provided to Stan from RStan?

messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Seed used in RStan
parts:
get_seed can be applied to the stanfit object as in the following example. 

> fit
Inference for Stan model: ncode.
4 chains: each with iter=2000; warmup=1000; thin=1; 2000 iterations saved.

       mean se_mean  sd  2.5%   25%   50%   75% 97.5% n_eff Rhat
mu      2.4       0 0.5   1.4   2.1   2.4   2.8   3.5  1332    1
sigma   3.2       0 0.4   2.6   2.9   3.1   3.4   4.0  1404    1
lp__  -64.4       0 1.0 -67.0 -64.8 -64.1 -63.6 -63.4   727    1

Samples were drawn using NUTS2 at Tue Oct 16 15:06:02 2012.
For each parameter, n_eff is a crude measure of effective sample size,
and Rhat is the potential scale reduction factor on split chains (at 
convergence, Rhat=1).
> 
> 
> get_seed(fit)
[1] 539398494
On Tue, Oct 16, 2012 at 4:35 PM, Daniel Lee <bea...@alum.mit.edu> wrote:
Is there an easy way to know what seed is provided to Stan from RStan?
